Open it to browse b"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ranches, switch branches, create one, merge one into the current branch, and commit a checked subset"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" of files — the commit message is written by the session's own model from the diff."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Two ways in; either one is enough."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### From the plugin page (GUI)"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Sidebar → **Plugins** → **Add plugin**, then put this in "Package or address":"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Press Install and enable it afterwards ("Enable"). Installing by package name is what makes versio"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"n comparison and updates possible."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**Restart `dsh web`** afterwards: host-half changes are not hot-reloaded, and the browser fetches th"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"e new client bundle on restart."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Updating"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"DSH does not auto-update third-party plugins; updating takes one command:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Then **restart `dsh web`**. Host-half changes (services and API routes) only apply after a restart; "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"the browser half refetches its bundle then."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Check the installed and latest versions:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Installs by GitHub address are not followed automatically (`pnpm` pinned a commit), so reinstall exp"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" address are not followed automatically (`pnpm` pinned a commit), so reinstall explicitly to update:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### From the CLI (a dedicated profile is recommended)"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The `headless` profile installs too, but it has no `webServer`: no `/api/dsh-git-flow/*` route is re"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"gistered, the browser half does not exist there, and boot reports no error."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### A machine without pnpm"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"dsh's plugin management — the plugin page's Install, and `dsh plugin …` — shells out to pnpm, and fa"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ils outright when there is none:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Install one (Node ships npm):"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Do not let Corepack use its own default: after a bare `corepack enable` you get pnpm **8.15.7**, whi"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"ch walks straight into the `ERR_PNPM_ADDING_TO_ROOT` failure below."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"If you would rather not install pnpm at all, the plugin itself does not need it (its `dependencies` "},{"id":"p31s2","text":"d rather not install pnpm at all, the plugin itself does not need it (its `dependencies` are empty):"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- **Use Node's npm**: `cd ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile> && npm install https://github.com/hunan36/dsh-gi"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"t-flow`
- **Copy the directory**: drop the whole `dsh-git-flow` folder (including `lib/`) into `<pro"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"file>/node_modules/`, for offline or fully manual setups"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Both need one extra step: add `@hunan36/dsh-git-flow` to that profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` in its"},{"id":"p33s2","text":" `package.json`, then restart `dsh web`. The plugin page and `dsh plugin add` do that for you; a man"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"ual install does not, and the package stays unloaded even though it sits in `node_modules`."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"### Point the plugin page at npm (a machine that only has npm)"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"The plugin page runs `pnpm add <spec>` by default, but the plugin manager's command is configurable "},{"id":"p35s2","text":"— set it to `npm` in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and the page installs with npm:"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## Security boundaries"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"- The browser sends only a `sessionId`. The host resolves the repository from that session's workspa"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"ce, so a page can never name a directory for git to run in.
- Arguments are always an array, never a"},{"id":"p39s3","text":" shell string, with `stdin: 'ignore'` and `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0`, so a credential prompt can never "},{"id":"p39s4","text":"hang a call.
- `push` never passes `--force` or `--force-with-lease`, and only pushes the current br"},{"id":"p39s5","text":"anch's upstream (with `--set-upstream <remote> HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>` when it has none).
- Commit"},{"id":"p39s6","text":"s stage only the files checked in the panel. An empty selection answers `git/no-files-selected` and "},{"id":"p39s7","text":"never falls back to an implicit `git add -A`.
- A merge runs only `git merge --no-edit <name>` again"},{"id":"p39s8","text":"st the current branch, with a branch name the browser sent. It never passes `--no-ff`/`--force`/`-X`"},{"id":"p39s9","text":", never pushes, and never aborts a conflicted merge.
- Branch actions run exactly one fixed git subc"},{"id":"p39s10","text":"ommand each: `git rebase <branch>`, `git fetch <remote>`, `git push <remote> <branch>:refs/heads/<de"},{"id":"p39s11","text":"st>`, `git branch -m <from> <to>`, `git branch -d|-D <branch>`. Remote names are only accepted when "},{"id":"p39s12","text":"they appear in `git remote`; fetch never prunes or resets; the checked-out branch can never be delet"},{"id":"p39s13","text":"ed; a `-D` force delete is only sent after the unmerged-branch warning and a second confirmation.
- "},{"id":"p39s14","text":"Switching branches on a dirty worktree fails by default (`git/dirty-worktree`). Only the user's seco"},{"id":"p39s15","text":"nd confirmation in the dialog sends `--force`.
- Discarding runs only after the destructive action i"},{"id":"p39s16","text":"s picked in a confirmation dialog: tracked paths go back to HEAD with `git restore --source=HEAD --s"},{"id":"p39s17","text":"taged --worktree`, untracked paths are removed with `git clean -fd` (no `-x`, so ignored files stay)"},{"id":"p39s18","text":", and a conflicted path is refused rather than guessed at.
- `workspaceRegistry` is read lazily thro"},{"id":"p39s19","text":"ugh `ctx.get('workspaceRegistry')` instead of being declared in `static inject`, so a profile withou"},{"id":"p39s20","text":"t one (the shipped `headless` profile) still activates this entry rather than leaving a permanently "},{"id":"p39s21","text":"pending plugin; every git call there answers `git/not-a-repository`.
